QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] The Call Of Evil Spirits
QuestInfo.0: Why was #b#p9073005##k unable to answer the whistle calls?\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9073005##k could not hear the whistle calls because the #bJr. Cerebes#k are barking so loudly. Defeat the monsters and return to Krag.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Jr. Cerebes, but the barking continues from the Dead Mine. Perhaps it was something else.\r\n

0.0: Scadur, that old goat, I knew he'd worry, but there was nothing I could do about it. The #bmonsters around here have been yapping and barking#k nonstop since that star fell. It completely blocked out the sound of his whistles.
0.1: It's those #bsavaged Jr. Cerebes#k. I'm grateful they're all bark and very little bite, but if I can't hear Scadur's calls, we've got ourselves a problem. Mind taking care of them? I'll send you into the depths of the Deep Mine if you agree.

yes.0: You're a whistle-saver. Taking out #b80 Jr. Cerebes#k monsters should be plenty to clear the air.

no.0: You just let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: What? You say you're done? But it's still so loud around here!\r\n

yes.0: Well, shoot. I must've picked on the wrong monsters. I kind of feel sorry for 'em now...

default.0: Take care of 80 Jr. Cerebes monsters, got it?
